text: Wet Dress Rehearsal DONE ✅ Electron is ready for its 96th launch and latest mission from Launch Complex 1 for synspective. "Owl By The Dozen" launch window opens tomorrow: 🚀 3:15pm NZST, Sept 19 🚀 03:15 UTC, Sept 19 🚀 12:15 pm JST, Sept 19 🚀 11:15 pm EDT, Sept 18 🚀 8:15 pm PDT, Sept 18

Neutron operations are busy on Virginia's Eastern Shore. Our Hungry Hippo fairing has wrapped up pre-flight testing at our Assembly and Integration Complex while down the road at Launch Complex 3, we've completed installation of the ~10m test stand for Neutron's second stage. Neutron's thrust module will be directly tested on the launch mount itself, to verify rocket-to-launch mount interfaces ahead of full vehicle tests on the pad.

Another dedicated ride to LEO is coming soon for synspective 🦉 🛰️ Electron will lift off this week from Launch Complex 1 to deliver the 12th StriX synthetic aperture radar satellite to space and continue the expansion of their Earth-monitoring constellation. "Owl By The Dozen" launch window opens: 🚀 3:15pm NZST, Sept 19 🚀 03:15 UTC, Sept 19 🚀 12:15 pm JST, Sept 19 🚀 11:15 pm EDT, Sept 18 🚀 8:15 pm PDT, Sept 18
